page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.large is an entry-tier virtual server belonging to the Compute Optimized instance family. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM virtualization, the instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory is provisioned at 4.0 GB, establishing a 2.0 GB per vCPU allocation. The hardware profile includes a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server model incorporates zero GPUs and contains no local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system deployment and persistent data operations. The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio delivers a dense compute allocation relative to RAM. This balance makes the instance applicable for compute-focused tasks with low memory requirements, such as lightweight microservices, build nodes, and simple web application backend handling. Tradeoffs include limited memory scaling and dependency on external storage volumes.
